name: capsule-creator
description: Create, build, verify, and smoke-test offline SQLite Capsule applications from reviewable source.

interface.longDescription: Scaffold reviewable capsule source, implement a bounded browser application, build the SQLite artifact with the Python host, and verify its format, integrity, endpoints, and embedded runbook.
